blocks.text: After years of negotiations, trade ministers from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) last week signed the Asean Digital Economy Framework Agreement (Defa), a landmark pact that promises to double the region’s burgeoning digital economy to $2 trillion by as early as 2030.
